subject.name: Electronics Engineers, Except Computer
subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 17-2072.00, research and design electronic components and systems for commercial, industrial, military, or scientific use: organize requirements and applicable standards; complete circuit design, simulation, and component selection; produce technical documents for checking, review, and signing; organize tests to verify conformity; and handle design changes.
